channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
FEniCS is a collection of free software for automated, efficient solution of differential equations
(https://fenicsproject.org). It provides C++ and Python interfaces, and creates effecient solvers via
expression of finite variational statements in a domain-specific language that are transformed and
just-in-time compiled into efficient implementations.
about.summary: The FInite element Automatic Tabulator FIAT supports generation of arbitrary order instances of the Lagrange elements on lines, triangles, and tetrahedra.

name: fenics-fiat
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2019.1.0"

package:
  name: fenics-fiat
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://bitbucket.org/fenics-project/fiat/downloads/fiat-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 341a1046cbe0f5f2eb26630c2f71f378b0dca51daf9892a54a2ff193970371e9
  patches:
    - sympy-1.14.patch
    - setuptools82.patch

build:
  number: 42
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - sympy >=1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - FIAT
      pip_check: false
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"

about:
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYING
    - COPYING.LESSER
  summary: The FInite element Automatic Tabulator FIAT supports generation of arbitrary order instances of the Lagrange elements on lines, triangles, and tetrahedra.
  description: |
    FEniCS is a collection of free software for automated, efficient solution of differential equations
    (https://fenicsproject.org). It provides C++ and Python interfaces, and creates effecient solvers via
    expression of finite variational statements in a domain-specific language that are transformed and
    just-in-time compiled into efficient implementations.
  homepage: https://www.fenicsproject.org
  repository: https://bitbucket.org/fenics-project/
  documentation: https://fenics.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - garth-wells
    - johannesring
    - mikaem
    - minrk
    - jan-janssen
    - sblauth
